scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm run db:ensure && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.toml && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm run db:ensure && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.toml
scripts.init:admin: echo 'Prefer POST /api/setup when users is empty. Or: ADMIN_USERNAME=... ADMIN_PASSWORD=... pnpm --filter @mankr/worker exec tsx scripts/init-admin.ts' && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS users FROM users"

COOKIES_SECRET.description: Required session cookie signing secret. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Required for outbound mail. Get a free key at [resend.com](https://resend.com) and verify your sending domain there.

EMAIL_DOMAIN.description: Your mail domain without `@` (e.g. `example.com`). Aliases become `local@EMAIL_DOMAIN`.
